description:
Ha Mookyung, the final powerhouse of the Dongnyeon Group, firmly holds the reins of the distribution industry in South Korea.  
To become the owner of the group, he must sweep away the small town of Baekya and establish the kingdom of Dongnyeon.  
The mission was easy, and the plan was flawless.  
Until he met the guardian of Baekya Village, the undercover police officer Chae Sunkyung.  
Until the moment I met you, I was just a nondescript, restless stray dog without any plans.

"Officer Chae, we're just going to kiss now, right?"

Dongnyeon's villain, who came to ruin the village Chae Sunkyung wants to protect.  
The villain from Dongnyeon who got entangled with Chae Sunkyung before his plans went awry.  
I am the sun rising in Dongnyeon. In your heart, I wanted to linger like the Baekya sun for a long time.
